item.title: 11/19/2026 10:00 AM INDEPENDENT REGULATORY REVIEW COMMISSION
item.description:
Public hearing on A meeting of the Independent Regulatory Review Commission has been scheduled for November 19, 2026 at 10:00 a.m. in the 8th Floor Conference Room, 555 Walnut Street. The agenda includes the following regulations:
1. No. 3458 State Board of Funeral Directors #16A-4832: Licensure by Endorsement 2. No. 3484 State Board of Certified Real Estate Appraisers #16A-7024: Licensure by Endorsement 3. No. 3488 Department of Transportation #18-491: Mid-Cabin Cameras 4. No. 3437 State Board of Psychology #16A-6317: Continuing Education 5. No. 3485 State Board of Certified Real Estate Appraisers #16A-7026: General Revisions – Certified Pennsylvania Evaluators 6. No. 3504 State Board of Cosmetology #16A-4524: Natural Hair Braiders (Final-Omit) 7. No. 3417 Department of Human Services #14-555: Psychiatric Residential Treatment Facilities 8. No. 3448 Department of Health #10-241: Vision Screening and Comprehensive Eye Exams 9. No. 3472 Environmental Quality Board #7-589: Safe Drinking Water Revised Consumer Confidence Report Rule 10. No. 3482 State Ethics Commission #63-09: General Revisions Necessitated by Court Opinions and Alignment with Modern Practices 11. No. 3500 Pennsylvania Gaming Control Board #125-262: Table Games Side Wager and Variations (Final-Omit) The next meeting is scheduled for Thursday, December 3, 2026.. - 8th Floor Conference Room 555 Walnut Street Harrisburg, PA
